Definition: from G2882; a Corinthian, i.e. inhabitant of Corinth:--Corinthian.
BiblicalUsage: Korinthios is a Corinthian, an inhabitant of Corinth. Acts 18:8 says many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized, and 2 Corinthians 6:11 has Paul saying, O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Corinthians are the church Paul loved and rebuked in the same breath: many believed and were baptized, and his heart was enlarged toward them.
